title: Hearty Crisp Mexican Chicken Tagine
description: A savory and crisp Mexican dish featuring chicken, Italian seasoning, and a blend of Sonoran flavors, cooked to perfection in a tagine pot using sous-vide techniques, suitable for flexitarian diets.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 165 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the chicken pieces with Italian seasoning, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the olive oil in the tagine pot over medium-high heat and sear the chicken until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the tagine pot and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the diced tomatoes and chicken broth to the tagine pot and stir to combine.
Place the tagine pot in the sous-vide machine and cook for 2 hours.
Remove the tagine pot from the sous-vide machine and let it cool slightly.
Crisp the top of the dish under the broiler for 5 minutes.
Serve the Hearty Crisp Mexican Chicken Tagine hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
